name: The Boy
summary: Luke Ellis wakes up at The Institute, a facility that abducts teenagers with psychic powers; Ms. Sigsby, the place's charismatic director, claims they're saving the world; Tim Jamieson hides from his haunted past as a small-town night knocker.

name: Shots for Dots
summary: Luke bonds with the other Front Half residents and begins plotting his escape; Ms. Sigsby manages the fallout from a security breach; in town, Tim begins to look into The Institute, only to find himself caught up in a high-stakes standoff.

name: Graduation
summary: Luke begins to plan his escape while Sigsby is distracted trying to expose Stackhouse's disloyalty; Tim loses a friend.

name: The Box
summary: As Luke's tests intensify, a new arrival causes problems for Sigsby; Tim isn't buying the official story about what happened to Annie.

name: Back Half
summary: Sigsby tricks Luke into confirming he's TP, forcing him to move up his escape attempt; Tim's suspicions put him on the Institute's radar.

name: Run
summary: As Tim's investigation pays off in ways he never imagined and Sigsby scrambles to avert disaster, Luke must finally decide who he can trust.

name: Hide
summary: Luke and Tim go on a desperate search for help as Sigsby uses all of her formidable assets in a last-ditch attempt to keep the Institute's secrets.

name: Fight
summary: Our characters come together for a final confrontation with unimaginable consequences.

name: The Reckoning
summary: After their climactic escape, Luke and friends plot to end the Institute for good; the Director enlists a new ally; Sigsby seeks a way back in.

name: The Sanctuary
summary: The crew is on the run once again; the Institute struggles after a setback; desperate, Luke makes a choice that may cost him everything he holds dear.

name: Double Cross
summary: Luke and friends adjust to their new surroundings; Sigsby sizes up Nolan as a potential rival; Tim chases his only lead in the search for an ally.

name: Truth and Consequences
summary: Luke uncovers a secret from the past that gives Sigsby questions; Tim thinks he has a lead; the Director employs a new interrogation technique.

name: The Scraper
summary: Tim's investigation takes a turn; Nolan and the Director work to keep the Institute from collapse; Luke finds the rabbithole goes much deeper.

name: Hinge
summary: Luke and Kalisha enlist an unlikely ally in their race against the clock; Tim and George scramble to reach their friends before it's too late.

name: Break On Through
summary: Our heroes head back into the lion's den; Luke, Tim, and the crew grapple with an impossible decision.

name: The Other Side
summary: The final confrontation; will our crew succeed in revealing the Institute's secrets or will Nolan and the Director sweep their crimes under the rug?
